+"""Checks for timestamp ordering and report rendering."""
+
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from app.report import render
+from app.timestamps import oldest, parse_ts
+
+
+def test_timestamps_and_report():
+    assert parse_ts("2026-08-29T01:06:05Z").tzinfo is not None
+    assert oldest([
+        "2026-08-29T10:06:06+09:00",
+        "2026-08-29T01:06:05Z",
+    ]) == "2026-08-29T01:06:05Z"
+
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        path = Path(tmp) / "events.jsonl"
+        events = [
+            {"at": "2026-08-29T10:06:06+09:00", "kind": "a"},
+            {"at": "2026-08-29T01:06:05Z", "kind": "b"},
+        ]
+        path.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(event) for event in events), encoding="utf-8")
+        assert render(str(path)) == "2 events\noldest: 2026-08-29T01:06:05Z"
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    test_timestamps_and_report()
+    print("ok")
